title: Tech Note: Converting C Dates into 4D Dates

historical_commentary.text: This note addresses the low-level challenge of converting between C date formats (typically Unix timestamps or GMT strings) and 4D's internal date representation, a common need when developing native plug-ins. The 4D Plugin Wizard and native C plug-in development approach have been largely superseded by 4D's built-in commands for date manipulation, HTTP/networking, and the ability to call system APIs. The note also references URL-related functionality, suggesting it was part of a broader internet/web development context typical of 1999. Modern 4D handles date conversions internally and provides extensive date/time functions.
related_updates: 4D Plugin SDK has evolved significantly since the v6 era
Modern 4D provides built-in date/time conversion and GMT handling commands
Components (written in 4D) have largely replaced native C plug-ins for many use cases
4D's built-in HTTP and networking commands handle date format conversions automatically
